mapper.select: select id, name, parent_id, color, use_count, create_time from media_tag order by use_count desc, name asc
select id, name, parent_id, color, use_count, create_time from media_tag where name = #{name} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into media_tag (name, parent_id, color, use_count) values (#{name}, #{parentId}, #{color}, 0)
mapper.update: update media_tag set parent_id = #{parentId} where id = #{id}
update media_tag set name = #{name} where id = #{id}
update media_tag set color = #{color} where id = #{id}
update media_video_tag set name = #{name} where tag_id = #{tagId}
update media_tag t set t.use_count = (select count(*) from media_video_tag v where v.tag_id = t.id) where t.id in #{tagId}
mapper.select: select t.id, t.name, t.parent_id, t.color, t.use_count, t.create_time from media_video_tag v inner join media_tag t on t.id = v.tag_id where v.video_id = #{videoId} order by t.name asc
mapper.delete: delete from media_video_tag where video_id = #{videoId} and tag_id is not null
mapper.insert: insert ignore into media_video_tag (video_id, facet, name, tag_id) select #{videoId}, '标签', t.name, t.id from media_tag t where t.id in #{tagId}
insert ignore into media_video_tag (video_id, facet, name, tag_id) select v.video_id, '标签', t.name, t.id from media_tag t cross join ( select #{videoId} as video_id ) v where t.id in #{tagId}
mapper.update: update media_video set rating = #{rating} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, video_id, pos, end_pos, label, color, create_time from media_video_marker where video_id = #{videoId} order by pos asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into media_video_marker (video_id, pos, end_pos, label, color) values (#{videoId}, #{pos}, #{endPos}, #{label}, #{color})
insert into media_video_marker (video_id, pos, end_pos, label, color) values (#{videoId}, #{pos}, #{endPos}, #{label}, #{color})
